_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#4. Confirms the 2026-08-03 correction (a DofsView and its .flatten() give BIT-IDENTICAL results, so the old 'silently wrong results' warning was stale) and pins the form that IS silently wrong, which the claim does not mention: a BOOLEAN MASK. condense(K, f, D=mask) is accepted without any warning and treats True/False as the integer indices 1/0, so almost nothing is constrained -- measured max|u| 8.8e-01 against the correct 7.03e-02 on MeshTri().refined(2) with unit_load. An empty D gives 5.6e+14 garbage. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 converts the boolean mask to the flat int index array condense's D actually wants (d_arg = np.flatnonzero(mask) instead of mask) -- the documented fix, applied at the D argument the pitfall is about. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 5 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 makes the boundary really constrained (max|u| 7.03e-02, the correct value), which removes 'boolean_mask_answer_is_wrong=True' and 'boolean_mask_max_over_correct_max_gt_5=True' and raises the forbidden 'FAIL:', so the fixture goes red.
